children: Dollar General is proud to recognize and celebrate
National Truck Driver Appreciation Week
, which runs through Saturday, September 19, 2026, by spotlighting DG Private Fleet employees and partner drivers for their dedication to serving DG customers.

“At Dollar General, we proudly celebrate Truck Driver Appreciation Week and the drivers behind the wheel of DG’s Private Fleet and our third-party carriers. To every driver supporting DG on the road and in our stores, THANK YOU,” said Rod West, Dollar General’s executive vice president of global supply chain. “Our drivers’ commitment to our mission, our customers, and our communities make it possible for our stores to serve millions of customers who rely on us each year. I’m grateful for our drivers’ dedication, contributions and pride in our mission to Serve Others. It’s an honor to celebrate you this week and support you throughout the year.”
This week, we are highlighting various team members on our DG Private Fleet team including:
Zarak S. – Alachua, FL

For Zarak S., the move from military service to trucking felt natural. While serving in the Marine Corps, he developed leadership, discipline and a strong sense of responsibility. Today, he brings those same values to his role with Dollar General Private Fleet.

Zarak credits his military experience with teaching him to follow procedures, treat others with respect and do the right thing, even when no one is watching. Those lessons have helped him succeed both on the road and in life.

When he joined Dollar General Private Fleet, Zarak wanted an opportunity to provide for his family. He found that opportunity with a company that he believes cares about its people and communities. He takes pride in helping move the business forward while working for an organization committed to making a difference.

Zarak believes veterans are well-positioned for success because of the discipline, work ethic and structure they gain through military service. His advice to fellow veterans is simple: “Put those military skills to work. With dedication and effort, trucking can offer a rewarding career and a strong future for your family.”
Melissa K. – Ardmore, OK (Fresh DC)

For Melissa K., trucking is more than a career. It has opened the door to growth, adventure, and new opportunities with Dollar General. After owning and operating a salon for eight years, she pursued a new challenge that offered her the chance to travel and build a rewarding career.

Melissa credits much of her success to the training and support she received at DG, which helped her build confidence behind the wheel from day one. She values the competitive benefits and regional routes that allow her to explore new places while staying connected to home.

Through hard work and determination, Melissa has built a successful career in trucking. Her advice for others considering the profession is simple: "Give it a try. It's been incredibly rewarding, and there are so many opportunities to learn, grow and explore."
Justin L. - Bowling Green, KY

Justin L. built a strong career in the Blair distribution center as a loader, trainer and supervisor while helping launch Fresh operations. Drawing on his experience operating heavy equipment in the military, he embraced the opportunity to take on a new challenge and grow his career by going through DG’s CDL program to join the DG Fleet.

With support from his trainer and DG Fleet leadership, Justin successfully navigated the transition. Today, he enjoys the independence that comes with being part of the DG Fleet and takes pride in the relationships he built with store teams. He also values the opportunity to work outdoors and play a direct role in supporting stores.
Justin encourages others to consider the program. His advice is simply to focus on teamwork and service. The career can be rewarding for those who enjoy helping others and getting the job done.
Luciano M. – San Antonio, TX (Fresh DC)

Luciano M. built his career with the DG Fleet through dedication, leadership, and a genuine passion for the job. As a member of the Road Team, he considers it a career highlight and takes pride in representing his fellow drivers, valuing the opportunity to share his experiences, support other drivers and provide helpful feedback.

Throughout his career, Luciano considers his commitment to safe driving to be one of his greatest accomplishments and continues to make it his top focus every day on the road. He also looks for ways to grow, both professionally and personally, while encouraging others to do the same.

By sharing his knowledge and experiences, Luciano helps drivers succeed and supports a culture of continuous improvement. He encourages others to pursue similar opportunities and offers this advice: “Stay committed, gain experience and take pride in your work.”
